card.name: Space before a percent or fold change
card.fires_on: The space right before a number that gives a size of change, such as a percentage or fold change. It follows words like decreased by, approximately, or increased an average of.

modes.label: Percent change
modes.description: Space after by, a or of, just before a number followed by a percent sign.
modes.example: was decreased by<< >>38% after administration of valpro

modes.label: Fold change
modes.description: Space after approximately, just before a fold-change number.
modes.example: were approximately<< >>2 fold higher when oxybutynin

card.writes: It pushes the model to write a percent sign or a word like percent or half after the number.
card.plain: It fires on the gap just before a number that says how much a drug level or dose changed, expecting a percent next.
